title: ShimmerBridge (LayerZero EndpointV1 lock/mint bridge) — live extractability

Receive path needs 4-of-4 LayerZero DVN attestations (3-of-3 on Fantom) + the default executor; commitVerification is permissionless but useless without the DVN quorum (fork-proven)
App-level trusted-remote check (40-byte path) + srcChainId==230 + PT_UNLOCK; wrong sender / wrong srcEid are stored, not executed (fork-proven)
